svg.title: LRU cache state at t=60: values in one map, recency in the policy's list
svg.desc: LocalCache.entries maps a, d, e to value and deadline. LruPolicy.nodes maps the same keys to list nodes. The list runs head, e, d, a, tail: e is most recent, a is the next victim.
svg.text: t=60, capacity 3: one map finds values, the list orders keys
upper arrows are next, lower arrows are prev
get(a) would unlink a and relink it just after head
